articles.title: India bonds under pressure before debt supply; hot inflation prints pinch further
articles.summary: Indian government bonds experienced significant selling pressure ahead of a major auction for the benchmark paper. The yield on the 6.94% 2036 bond rose notably due to rising inflation in both India and the United States. Moreover, US Treasury yields remained elevated as markets anticipate larger interest rate hikes.
